name: purple-latex-bedroom-portrait
image_purpose: fashion social content and editorial profile visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic indoor fashion portrait of an adult woman posed confidently on a bed in a modern softly lit bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: One adult woman with an original non-celebrity identity, dark brown-to-black long straight hair, realistic natural skin texture, and a confident composed expression. She wears a deep-purple high-gloss latex-inspired crop top with a central zipper, a matching structured high-waisted mini skirt with secure coverage, and deep-purple thigh-high patent boots with high heels. Keep the styling editorial and the anatomy natural without exaggeration.
prompt.composition_elements: Seat the adult woman diagonally on a bed with her torso upright and slightly supported by the hips. One arm bends with the hand near the jawline and the other stabilizes her posture. One leg is raised in a controlled fashion pose while the other folds beneath her, keeping both legs clearly separated. Include neutral bedroom walls, a visible door, subtle decor, clean bedding, and a softly organized modern interior.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural light diffused across the room with gentle warm highlights on skin and glossy purple materials, smooth realistic shadow gradients, and an intimate elegant cinematic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail fashion portrait, natural perspective, realistic latex-inspired specular highlights, skin, hair, bedding, and room texture, editorial clarity, no text or watermark.
